title: End-to-End Record Pipeline Tests
requirements: Build stub/fake AudioRecorder and stubbed TranscriptionService (conforming to injected protocols) returning a fixed small .m4a fixture URL and a deterministic TranscriptUpdate.final — no real microphone or network

Write an integration test that drives RecordingViewModel through start() → brief wait → stop(), asserts completedEntry is non-nil, then calls ListViewModel.finishRecording(entry:) and asserts the resulting DiaryEntry appears in store.entries()
Verify onCompleted is invoked with the persisted DiaryEntry and ListViewModel.isRecording resets to false
acceptance_criteria: One end-to-end pipeline test in CI drives start→stop→finalize→persist and asserts a persisted DiaryEntry
Test runs in <2 seconds without microphone or network access
Test is isolated to a temp directory (NSTemporaryDirectory) and cleans up in tearDown
